rca_of_issue: ProposalModal renders a non-scrollable bottom sheet with multiline content and footer action. At 390x844 the sheet exceeds the viewport, so the action is clipped and Playwright reports it outside the viewport. Backend proposal/message routes exist but index.tsx never invokes them.
